component.name: TODO BIRD
component.summary: Offline Desktop Personal Assistant & Task Manager

description.p: TODO BIRD is an offline-first desktop personal assistant, interactive Gantt scheduler, and task manager designed for privacy, focus, and local data sovereignty.
Unlike web-based subscription tools, TODO BIRD runs 100% locally on your machine with zero telemetry and zero cloud lock-in.

ul.li: Interactive WBS and Gantt scheduling engine with visual dependencies
Comprehensive task and subtask status workflow
Local-first SQLite storage for complete privacy and data ownership
Avocet voice companion with local-time aware greetings
Dark and light modern neumorphic themes

description.p: Initial stable release of Todo Bird for Linux desktop.
